title: Allocate Minimum Pages
inputFormat: Implement allocateMinimumPages(arr, m), where arr contains book page counts in shelf order and m is the number of students.
outputFormat: The smallest possible maximum pages assigned to a student, or -1 when m exceeds arr.length.

visuals.title: Keep each student’s books together
